title: Social Media & Digital Marketing Executive
description:
JBAC Innovations is a product company in Gandhinagar. You will handle marketing for two products:
 


* **QEase** 
 — software for hospitals and clinics to manage patient queues and appointments
* **Buzzire** 
 — a face\-verified dating app, live on Google Play in Pune, Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar and other cities



 These are two very different audiences. Hospital owners on one side, young app users on the other. You need to be comfortable switching between both.
 



**What you will do:** 



* Run Buzzire's existing social accounts — Instagram, X, Facebook, YouTube — and grow them
* Build QEase's presence from zero — LinkedIn and content for hospital owners
* Create posts, reels and short videos for both
* Run paid ads: Google and LinkedIn for QEase, and app install campaigns for Buzzire
* Track results — installs, signups and demo requests. Not just likes and reach.
* Report monthly on what worked and what did not



**What we need:** 



* **2–4 years in social media or digital marketing**
* You have personally run an ad account. Please share screenshots or examples with real spend.
* You can write in English, Gujarati and Hindi
* Basic design and video editing (Canva, CapCut are fine)
* Portfolio required — accounts you handled, ads you ran, content you made



**Good to have:** 
 consumer app marketing, app install campaigns, healthcare or B2B experience, SEO
 



**To apply:** 
 Send CV and portfolio to info@jbacinnovations.com, subject "Social Media Executive"

 We are hiring a

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
**Job Description: Digital Marketing Executive** 









**Role Overview:﻿** 




  





 We are looking for a creative and analytical Digital Marketing Executive to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for planning, executing, and managing digital marketing campaigns, while also producing high\-quality content to drive engagement, brand awareness, and lead generation. A strong understanding of social media trends, and content marketing strategies is essential.
 



  
 



**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





**·** 
 Digital Marketing (Lead Generation \& Brand Awareness).
 



 · Plan and run ad campaigns (Google Ads, Meta Ads) for rooftop solar.
 



 · Create visually engaging graphics and marketing materials using Canva and Adobe Photoshop for social media posts, ads, and email campaigns.
 



 · Popups\-forms, and campaign funnels using tools like Zoho/Unbounce.
 



 · Manage and analyze WhatsApp/Google Form/CRM integration and response flow.
 



 · Plan and execute all digital marketing, including SEO/SEM, marketing database, email, social media and display advertising campaigns.
 



 · Design, build and maintain our social media presence.
 



 · Measure and report performance of all digital marketing campaigns, and assess against goals (ROI and KPIs).
 



 · Plan, execute, and measure experiments and conversion tests.
 



 · Collaborate with internal teams to create landing pages and optimize user experience.
 



 · Utilize strong analytical ability to evaluate end\-to\-end customer experience across multiple channels and customer touch points.
 








**Qualifications \& Skills:** 




  





**·** 
 Create visually engaging graphics and marketing materials using Canva and Adobe. Photoshop for social media posts, ads, and email campaigns.
 



 · Strong command of Google Ads, Facebook Ads, GA4, Search Console, Google Sheets.
 



 · Bonus: Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or GIS/heatmap tools.
 



 · Ability to translate data into business actions and insights.
 



 · Creativity and attention to detail.
 



 ·  Hands\-on experience with social media platforms and ad managers.
 








**Company Overview:** 




  





 Ample Solar Private Limited is a Gujarat based solar company delivering scalable renewable energy solutions from rooftop systems, ground mounted solar projects to multi megawatt industrial solar projects. The company serves residential customers, MSMEs, and large industries with a strong focus on engineering quality and execution excellence.  
 



  





 With 3000\+ operations completed and demonstrated capability in MW scale project execution, Ample Solar supports large industrial clients in achieving energy cost optimization and sustainability targets. Backed as an authorized Tata Group channel partner, the company brings good quality components, structured processes, and reliable delivery across all project sizes. Ample Solar is also entered a phase of strategic multi state expansion, strengthening its presence in key industrial corridors to support India’s clean energy transition. 
 



  





**Interested candidates meeting the above mentioned requirements can directly apply or share their resume.** 




  





 Interested candidates may share their CV at: hr@amplesolar.in

title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 Jashom Technologies builds scalable digital and AI\-driven solutions that help businesses innovate faster, operate efficiently, and grow with confidence. The company specializes in AI product development, generative AI, custom LLM applications and RAG system.
 



  





**Job Location:** 
 Work From Office.
 



  





 Jashom focuses on reliable, secure, and cloud\-ready solutions, including intelligent chatbots, workflow automation, GPU\-optimized AI systems, and modern APIs. Acting as a long\-term technology partner, Jashom emphasizes clarity, transparency, and measurable outcomes. The team works with both startups and enterprises, supporting them in turning complex ideas into impactful, high\-performance products.
 



  





**Role Description:** 




  





 The Digital Marketing Executive will be responsible for planning, executing, and optimizing digital marketing campaigns that support Jashom’s growth and brand visibility.
 



  





 We are looking for a creative and performance\-driven
 **Social Media \& Performance Marketing Executive** 
 who can take ownership of our social media presence, develop and execute social media strategies, run paid advertising campaigns, and create high\-quality product content using modern AI tools.
 



 This is not just a content\-posting role. We are looking for someone who understands
 **social media strategy \+ content creation \+ paid advertising \+ AI\-powered video production** 
 and can turn our technology and products into engaging content that generates awareness, leads, and business opportunities.
 



  





  





**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess strong Marketing skills, including campaign planning, brand positioning, and lead generation.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills for crafting clear messaging and collaborating with cross\-functional teams.
* Candidates should possess Social Media Marketing skills for managing platforms, engaging audiences, and growing online presence.
* Candidates should possess Web Content Writing skills for creating concise, engaging, and technically accurate digital content.
* Candidates should possess Web Analytics skills to measure performance, interpret data, and optimize digital campaigns.
* Relevant qualifications include a bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
* Additional beneficial skills include familiarity with SEO/SEM, email marketing tools, CRM platforms, and basic design or creative tools.
* Previous experience in tech or AI\-focused companies and the ability to work independently in a fast\-paced environment are preferred.
